name.value: Golden Smell Mee Malaysian Singaporeon Cuisine

description.value: Golden Smell Mee is a Malaysian-Singaporean restaurant in Vancouver's Chinatown reuniting two family culinary legacies that trace back to 1986. The menu centres on handmade noodles, laksa, roti canai, Hainanese chicken rice, and slow-cooked curries drawing on Malay, Chinese, and Indian influences. A touring cyclist stopping in the Chinatown area will find a cozy, full-service dine-in restaurant with online ordering.

address.value: 142 East Pender Street, Vancouver, BC V6A 1T3
